fieldValues.title: The clerk: deployment
fieldValues.purpose: Which reviewed version of the clerk runs where.
fieldValues.inside: The clerk's reusable workflows and the pins in a programme repo that select a clerk commit.
fieldValues.outside: Reviewing the code being deployed: that happens at the source PR.
fieldValues.authority_basis: Programme coordination (346e323e, affirmed); a8bc55ef and 926c059f (ratified 2026-10-20). Held by the central group until a group for Programme coordination is chartered.
fieldValues.revision_condition: When a rule cannot be placed in exactly one layer, or two principles on one tension collide inside this layer.
